parameters.query:
SELECT
  b.batch_id, b.beer_name, b.current_phase, b.start_date, b.prep_alerted_for_phase, b.recipe_id,
  dp.device_id AS pill_id, dp.device_name AS pill_name,
  dc.device_id AS controller_id, dc.device_name AS controller_name
FROM batches b
JOIN devices dp ON dp.device_id = b.pill_device_id
JOIN devices dc ON dc.device_id = b.temp_controller_device_id
WHERE b.status = 'active';

WITH pill_series AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('t', time_utc, 'sg', gravity_sg, 'temp', temperature_c) ORDER BY time_utc ASC) AS series
  FROM pill_readings WHERE device_id = $1
),
controller_series AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('t', time_utc, 'temp', temperature_c, 'target', target_temperature_c) ORDER BY time_utc ASC) AS series
  FROM temp_controller_readings WHERE device_id = $2
),
control_series AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('t', changed_at, 'old', old_value, 'new', new_value, 'by', changed_by, 'remark', remark) ORDER BY changed_at ASC) AS series
  FROM control_log
  WHERE device_id = $2 AND action = 'set_target_temperature' AND changed_at >= $3
),
recipe_info AS (
  SELECT r.name AS recipe_name, r.style_name, r.og AS recipe_og, r.fg AS recipe_fg,
         r.fermentation_temp_c AS recipe_fermentation_temp_c,
         r.raw_data->'fermentation'->'steps' AS fermentation_steps,
         y.name AS yeast_name, y.min_temp_c AS yeast_min_temp_c, y.max_temp_c AS yeast_max_temp_c,
         y.attenuation AS yeast_attenuation, y.min_attenuation AS yeast_min_attenuation, y.max_attenuation AS yeast_max_attenuation
  FROM recipes r
  LEFT JOIN yeasts y ON trim(lower(y.name)) = trim(lower(r.yeast_name))
  WHERE r.recipe_id = NULLIF($9, 'null')
),
last_change AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(changed_at), $3::timestamptz) AS t
  FROM control_log WHERE device_id = $2 AND action = 'set_target_temperature'
),
gap_window AS (
  -- ตัดช่วง transient หลังปรับ target ใหม่ๆ ออก (2 ชม.แรก) และไม่ย้อนไกลเกิน 12 ชม.
  -- (สภาพห้อง/ตู้อาจเปลี่ยนไปแล้ว) เพื่อเอาแค่ช่วงที่ระบบนิ่งจริงๆ มาเฉลี่ยส่วนต่าง
  SELECT GREATEST((SELECT t FROM last_change) + INTERVAL '2 hours', now() - INTERVAL '12 hours') AS t
),
gap_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(p.temperature_c - c.temperature_c) AS avg_gap, COUNT(*) AS n_points
  FROM pill_readings p
  JOIN temp_controller_readings c
    ON c.device_id = $2
    AND c.time_utc BETWEEN p.time_utc - INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND p.time_utc + INTERVAL '10 minutes'
  WHERE p.device_id = $1
    AND p.time_utc >= (SELECT t FROM gap_window)
)
SELECT
  $4::int AS batch_id,
  $5::text AS beer_name,
  $6::text AS current_phase,
  $7::text AS prep_alerted_for_phase,
  $8::text AS controller_name,
  $1::uuid AS pill_id,
  $2::uuid AS controller_id,
  $3::timestamptz AS start_date,
  NULLIF($9, 'null') AS recipe_id,
  COALESCE(ps.series, '[]'::jsonb) AS pill_series,
  COALESCE(cs.series, '[]'::jsonb) AS controller_series,
  COALESCE(ctl.series, '[]'::jsonb) AS control_series,
  ri.recipe_name, ri.style_name, ri.recipe_og, ri.recipe_fg, ri.recipe_fermentation_temp_c,
  COALESCE(ri.fermentation_steps, '[]'::jsonb) AS fermentation_steps,
  ri.yeast_name, ri.yeast_min_temp_c, ri.yeast_max_temp_c, ri.yeast_attenuation, ri.yeast_min_attenuation, ri.yeast_max_attenuation,
  gc.avg_gap AS stable_gap_c, gc.n_points AS stable_gap_points
FROM (SELECT 1) AS anchor
LEFT JOIN pill_series ps ON true
LEFT JOIN controller_series cs ON true
LEFT JOIN control_series ctl ON true
LEFT JOIN recipe_info ri ON true
LEFT JOIN gap_calc gc ON true;

INSERT INTO phase_log (batch_id, gravity_sg, temperature_c, gravity_velocity, detected_phase, ai_reasoning, controller_temp_c, target_temperature_c, abv_percent)
VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($3, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($4, 'null')::numeric, $5, $6, NULLIF($7, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($8, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($9, 'null')::numeric);
UPDATE batches SET current_phase = $1, last_alert_at = now(), prep_alerted_for_phase = NULL WHERE batch_id = $2;
UPDATE batches SET prep_alerted_for_phase = $1, last_prep_alert_at = now() WHERE batch_id = $2;

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ content: $json.content, components: ($json.is_last && $json.recommended_controller_target_c != null) ? [{ type: 1, components: [{ type: 2, style: 1, label: '🌡️ ปรับ target → ' + $json.recommended_controller_target_c.toFixed(2) + '°C', custom_id: 'settemp|' + $json.batch_id + '|' + $json.recommended_controller_target_c.toFixed(2) + '|' + ($json.next_phase || 'transition') }] }] : undefined }) }}
